about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Gwen Moore

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PREVENTING WASTE, FRAUD, AND ABUSE IN TANF ACT
statements.title: PREVENTING WASTE, FRAUD, AND ABUSE IN TANF ACT
sentences: I want to say to my colleagues, my Republican friends, that I agree with them that the way this program, TANF, was designed, it was a fraudster's dream.
It was not just since poor Brett Favre, the Wisconsin quarterback, built the volleyball court with TANF dollars, poor thing getting blamed for it.

Before then, States were balancing their budgets with TANF money; cities were building infrastructure projects with TANF dollars; and CEOs who ran the welfare programs in our States were getting bonuses for denying welfare recipients benefits.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOSTERING THE FUTURE ACT
statements.title: FOSTERING THE FUTURE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I am so excited to join all of my colleagues on the floor today in support of Fostering the Future Act, the Chafee bill package that is the first modern improvement of the Chafee Act, as my colleagues have indicated, since 1999 when the program was created.
I am so privileged to be able to fight for foster youth, including meeting youth who have lived experience in the foster care system.

So often I hear from these youth about their experiences in foster care, and although they are very resilient, the ones we get to talk to, they will tell you that as they age out of foster care, the likelihood of them becoming homeless and feeling abandoned is disproportionately great for this cohort.
Approximately 20,000 youth age out of foster care each year, and of that, approximately 25 percent of them experience homelessness.
Mr. Speaker, many report that they can't achieve permanency with an adoptive, foster, or kinship family.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANOTHER BLIGHT ON AMERICAN HISTORY
statements.title: ANOTHER BLIGHT ON AMERICAN HISTORY
sentences: It has been 13 days since the Supreme Court acted in the Callais decision, but it is a long history since the 19th century of trying to disenfranchise formerly enslaved people.

As a matter of fact, when I was in the State legislature, I fought our then-Governor over seemingly innocent requirements for voter ID because I knew that that was the camel's nose under the tent to disenfranchise people.
And while I am heartbroken by what the Supreme Court did 13 days ago, this ain't new.
We saw Supreme Court decisions.
You have heard from many speakers today, and I won't consume all the time by talking and going on and on.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SURVIVOR JUSTICE TAX PREVENTION ACT
statements.title: SURVIVOR JUSTICE TAX PREVENTION ACT
sentences: I am thinking about the accounts of trusted gymnast physicians abusing star athletes and the victims of Jeffrey Epstein and many of his associates.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues in the House to support this effort to make the tax code better serve all survivors who receive settlements after prevailing against their abusers by not saddling them with a tax bill or having to fight the IRS.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR TAX POLICIES THAT SUPPORT WORKING FAMILIES
statements.title: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR TAX POLICIES THAT SUPPORT WORKING FAMILIES
sentences: I will tell you, I have never celebrated tax day until today because I have the distinguished opportunity to comment on the one big, ugly billionaire's bill.

Even considering the crumbs from the American table that Republicans have tossed to working families, this pales in comparison to the increased costs of healthcare, food, utilities, gasoline, and almost every product.
Then, on top of all of this, Americans are facing the $1.2 trillion cuts in Medicaid.

As we mark tax day this year, one thing is really clear: Republicans have oversold their legislative accomplishment and riddled it with gimmicks for working-class Americans while brandishing massive giveaways to millionaires and billionaires.
Mr. Speaker, Republicans gave millionaires a tax cut that is 390 times the size of what they gave to workers and families making less than $50,000.
The one big, beautiful bill for billionaires made the benefits for billionaires permanent and made no tax on tips temporary.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF THE REVEREND JESSE LOUIS JACKSON, SR.
statements.title: COMMEMORATING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF THE REVEREND JESSE LOUIS JACKSON, SR.
sentences: I saw with my own eyes the Reverend Jackson comforting a victim of police brutality, the murder of Dontre Hamilton, and coming there to support us in the protest and to comfort the mother of this victim.
An unarmed Black man, lying on a park bench, was found dead at the hands of a policeman.
I won't mention any names, Mr. Speaker.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: END CRUEL IMMIGRATION ENFORCEMENT AGAINST KIDS
statements.title: END CRUEL IMMIGRATION ENFORCEMENT AGAINST KIDS
sentences: DHS facilities often fail to meet the basic standards of care, decent and adequate food, including medical care and mental health care.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to the Trump administration's careless and cruel family separation policies.
We just cannot stand by and watch while the administration forcibly separates families, inflicts long-term trauma on our Nation's youth, and strips our youth of safety and dignity.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICAN WATER STEWARDSHIP ACT
statements.title: AMERICAN WATER STEWARDSHIP ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in support of legislation before the House today reauthorizing the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative or GLRI.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025
sentences: We have to reject the so-called SAVE America Act and save our free and fair elections and save our democracy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I include in the Record a news article titled: ``Child care providers reporting unnerving stakeouts'' by Kristen Taketa.

What it does, it carves out an earmark for an industry with a narrow ideological mission to provide, I guess what I call anti- abortion, but Mr. Chairman over there, he called it pro-life counseling services.
Actually, this just does not fit within the four core purposes of the TANF bill, which is why the Biden administration prohibited this.

No more that we provide moneys for abortion counseling, which if you stop and think about it, it would fit more neatly into the core provisions of the TANF bill, and that is to prevent unwanted pregnancies.
We don't provide abortion clinics with TANF moneys nor should we provide it to these clinics.
Mr. Speaker, I hear the tortured explanation of how this fits into the core duties of the TANF bill, and I hear them talking about the diapers and the formula and all the wonderful things.
The March of Dimes provides all that stuff, too, but we don't provide them with TANF funds.

No. This is a diversion from the already underfunded TANF program which has been flat funded for 30 years at $16.5 billion and now we have, according to the chairman, millions of women, 2 million, and 7,000 centers that are now going to be able to access TANF dollars.

These TANF dollars were meant not to provide baby wipes and diapers for babies up to 6 months old, but to help a woman navigate her way into the workforce to get job training, to have cash assistance until she can get on her feet, not to provide moneys to stand up this ideological and, quite frankly, religious organization.

Mr. Speaker, I am going to later on offer an amendment that would allow States to use TANF dollars, again, not undermining this bill, but adding a section that would allow States to use TANF dollars for security at childcare facilities and to be able to gather evidence of harassment of childcare providers and to give local law enforcement the ability to secure a place for children because one of the core responsibilities of the TANF funding is to provide childcare.
This all comes because there have been vigilantes showing up at childcare centers.

These are people who are not Health Department officials, not auditors showing up and harassing TANF recipients who need childcare as we deny States' moneys for childcare, but we have vigilantes, right-wingers that are showing up and they are creating safety concerns in our daycares.
Right now, people can use TANF dollars for funding.

While sharing her initial visit, Faith said that the center specifically told her: ``Anything you need, we will help you get it.'' She was shunned by her family and pressured by her fiance to abort their unborn child.

As I indicated, my amendment, Mr. Speaker, would be added onto section 2 of the bill and would just enable childcare centers--TANF to fund childcare centers, which are now under siege and really compromising the security of our children.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to H.R. 6945.
That is why I oppose this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AGOA EXTENSION ACT
statements.title: AGOA EXTENSION ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I urge support of the bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HAITI ECONOMIC LIFT PROGRAM EXTENSION ACT
statements.title: HAITI ECONOMIC LIFT PROGRAM EXTENSION ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise today in support of the reauthorization of the Haiti-specific U.S. trade preference programs.
Mr. Speaker, I urge support of this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
statements.title: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
sentences: The ACA tax credits are expiring December 31.
The ACA premium tax credits have provided healthcare access for 15 years to over 20 million people who were previously uninsured.
The ACA has saved lives, but time is up.
I know that my own Senator, Ron Johnson, a millionaire, has told me he would be just fine reverting to the pre-ACA world of high-risk pools and plans with limited benefits.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOSPITAL INPATIENT SERVICES MODERNIZATION ACT
statements.title: HOSPITAL INPATIENT SERVICES MODERNIZATION ACT
sentences: I will offer them the opportunity to maybe extend the Affordable Care Act to the 24 million Americans who are facing unprecedented enormous health insurance premium hikes since we are extending healthcare stuff today.

My constituents and your constituents, Mr. Speaker, Americans from coast to coast are going to be staring down these massive amounts of medical debt, massive insurance premiums, or the inability to access healthcare.

They come on the heels of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act that slashed more than 10 million Americans out of healthcare through the Medicaid program, cut over a trillion dollars in Medicare, and a half-trillion dollar liability in the Medicare fund.

Mr. Speaker, the majority was more than happy to make a whole host of tax breaks permanent for the billionaire business class, but not for these entrepreneurs and families who are facing these tremendous hikes in their premiums.
The ballroom keeps getting bigger and bigger, so I can't describe the dimensions of it, but it is going to have a marble bathroom in it and a fancy new patio, but no healthcare for families.
American families, unless they are billionaires, are struggling to stay afloat in this economy.
We have 60 percent of folks who get healthcare through their employer or government or labor unions.
We are going to heap the costs onto middle-class families from every angle.
Mr. Speaker, while I support this bill, I object to how the majority and the President are making life worse every single day for most Americans.
While we are passing legislation, I hope that before we adjourn, we will not ignore the thousand-pound elephant in the room, and that is the Republican Party standing in the way of doing it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CLAIMING AGE CLARITY ACT
statements.title: CLAIMING AGE CLARITY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 5284, the Claiming Age Clarity Act.

He noted, in our committee report, this bill ``doesn't solve the big picture on Social Security, which this committee presides over, nor does it fix the data privacy, customer service, or staffing disaster that DOGE and this administration have put on this agency, but it will help on the margins, and I am glad that this little bill is seeing the light today.'' Mr. Speaker, this bill passed the Committee on Ways and Means with overwhelming bipartisan support.
I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support this commonsense legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPROVING SOCIAL SECURITY'S SERVICE TO VICTIMS OF IDENTITY THEFT ACT
statements.title: IMPROVING SOCIAL SECURITY'S SERVICE TO VICTIMS OF IDENTITY THEFT ACT
sentences: I certainly support H.R. 5345, the Improving Social Security's Service to Victims of Identity Theft Act, and of course, this passed the Ways and Means Committee with overwhelming bipartisan support.
I think having a single person to deal with at the Social Security office is common sense, and it will enable a victim to unravel their problems a lot sooner.

I just want to make note of the fact that, like some other Social Security bills that are under consideration today, this bill does not fix the crisis that this Trump administration has inflicted on Social Security when it comes to data privacy and customer service.

Thumb drives went into our central data computers by DOGE employees, people who had not been confirmed by any Senate or anything else, and our Social Security information was captured--captured indeed--on thumb drives.

Democrats are going to continue to fight to protect Americans from having their personal Social Security information politicized or bought and sold to the highest bidder or their Social Security benefits put at risk.

While this bill will have a modest but meaningful improvement to Social Security's customer service to the victims of identity theft, and I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to vote for this legislation, I want them to think more deeply about what we need to do in the atmosphere that we are in now to protect Americans' Social Security data that was mined by DOGE.

I would hope that the authors of this legislation and the chairman of the committee would recognize that this will mean that they will have to stop taking the appropriations away from the Social Security Administration.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SOCIAL SECURITY CHILD PROTECTION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SOCIAL SECURITY CHILD PROTECTION ACT OF 2025
sentences: I certainly think that H.R. 5348, the Social Security Child Protection Act of 2025, which passed the Ways and Means Committee with overwhelming bipartisan support, deserves to be supported by this body.
As has been indicated, this legislation would direct the SSA to issue a new Social Security number to a child under 14 if it was stolen in the course of being mailed.
Mr. Speaker, this is a commonsense bill, and it will strengthen customer service for children whose Social Security card has been lost or stolen in the mail.
If providing greater customer service through the Social Security Administration is a goal that has strong bipartisan support, I think that that really gives us a runway to do bigger things.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STORIES FROM HOME: THE HUMAN COST OF EXPIRING HEALTHCARE TAX CREDITS
statements.title: STORIES FROM HOME: THE HUMAN COST OF EXPIRING HEALTHCARE TAX CREDITS
sentences: For millions of families, individuals, small business owners covered by the Affordable Care Act (ACA), so is their health care.
So we can lift up these voices as we work to help bring them relief and pass legislation to extend those ACA premium tax credits.
Like millions of Americans, Wesley and his family depend on the subsidies provided through the Affordable Care Act (ACA).
Wesley wrote to me explaining that the extension of ACA subsidies has allowed him to afford healthcare for his entire family.
He's one of over 300,000 Wisconsinites covered by the ACA.
Or Robert from Milwaukee: I was on Medicaid until I made just $200 too much, at which time I was kicked off.
Or Dennis from Milwaukee: For thousands of Americans like me, the ACA is not a political talking point, it is the wall between a bearable, if difficult, life and complete financial and medical ruin.

I relied on the ACA's Marketplace for my health coverage, the only way I could secure a policy that didn't deny me for my age, that capped my out-of-pocket costs, and that allowed me to maintain my own health.
Now, with funding cuts and legislative actions targeting the core of the ACA, that coverage is dissolving.

With the protections and financial assistance of the ACA gone, her medical bills--for chemotherapy, hospice, hospital stays, and medication--could easily become astronomical, costs that studies show quickly bankrupt families even with good insurance.
President Trump and Republicans have had over a decade to develop an alternative healthcare plan--ever since they began proclaiming their intent to dismantle the ACA.
The ACA tax credits ensure that families, seniors, young adults, and workers have access to quality healthcare.
Therefore, we must continue working to extend the ACA tax credits to ensure Americans have access to affordable, reliable healthcare. ____________________
I will continue fighting to protect your pocketbooks as we defend your right to affordable healthcare.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Climate change is making those challenges worse.
Mr. Chair, I rise in support of my amendment No. 233 to the FY 2026 Defense Appropriations bill.
I urge support for my amendment. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, if you are a Republican with misgivings about the massive debt that this bill creates or if you are worried about stripping 17 million Americans of healthcare access, I tell you that now is your moment. ``A coward dies a thousand times before his death, but the valiant taste of death but once.'' That is a quote from Shakespeare.

Better to vote your conscience today and face an angry tweet than have your legacy be one of equivocation and cowardice. ``By their deeds you will know them.'' I urge all of my colleagues to oppose debt, death, and hunger.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: The majority justifies slashing hundreds of billions of dollars from Medicaid, undermining the ACA, cutting half a trillion dollars in Medicare, adding trillions to the debt, and facilitating the dismantling of care from hospitals, community health centers, and nursing homes to finance billionaire tax cuts.
Mr. Speaker, I will yield back, but I will not yield my soul.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EDUCATION IS OF GREAT IMPORTANCE TO CONGRESSIONAL BLACK CAUCUS, CONGRESS, AND CONSTITUENTS
statements.title: EDUCATION IS OF GREAT IMPORTANCE TO CONGRESSIONAL BLACK CAUCUS, CONGRESS, AND CONSTITUENTS
sentences: I rise, Mr. Speaker, to oppose assertions that DEI are ``wicked ideologies.'' I rise to speak against the notion that diversity, equity, and inclusion cause division and hostility toward White males.
Don't you take it awful hard 'Cause I laugh like I've got gold mines Diggin' in my own backyard.
I rise to oppose the President's deleting information from websites, such as to honor people like the Honorable Harriet Tubman.
I rise to oppose book banning.
I rise to oppose the idea that Pell grants are a part of the remnants of extremist education that is against, of course, the nuclear family.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Madam Chair, Republicans pretend to care about the Nation's debt and annual deficits, but they have instructed Ways and Means to add $4.5 trillion to the debt to provide tax cuts to the wealthiest.
I will tell you what, there will be crumbs from the master's table for the average American earning under $200,000 a year versus tax cuts for the wealthiest corporations and individuals.

Let me tell you, the handouts to the wealthiest will come on the backs of the least of us, from affordable healthcare through the ACA and Medicaid, veterans healthcare, nursing home coverage, food assistance, student loan repayment options, energy tax credits, national security, and cancer research.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ADDRESSING THE HACK OF U.S. TREASURY PAYMENT SYSTEMS
statements.title: ADDRESSING THE HACK OF U.S. TREASURY PAYMENT SYSTEMS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this was not an oath that they gave to the Democrats, this was not an oath that they gave just to the Republicans, this is an oath that we all took, and the insurrection continues.
The insurrection really started, I think, December 14, 2020, when all of the electors in various States had put together their scheme and the plot to overturn the government.
January 6, 2021, we saw the beginning of the insurrection.
Four years later, we re-elected Donald Trump and the insurrection continues.

It started with just pardoning violent criminals, people who caused the death by suicide and other means of police officers, who speared them and caused injuries to police officers and the insurrection continues.
We now have unelected billionaires who have broken into the Treasury Department and this is not a political grab for power; it is a crime what they did.
Stop getting their Social Security numbers.
We have unelected billionaires running the country.

The insurrection is continuing, and it is affecting you whether you are a Head Start child out there who needs it, a senior in a nursing home who will get inadequate care-- you are going to be lying in your feces for 10 hours because they are cutting Medicaid--or a farmer who has not gotten your USDA funding.

I will read it and remind you, Mr. Speaker, of this oath of office: I do solemnly swear that I will support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic; that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the same; that I take this obligation freely, without any mental reservation or purpose of evasion; and that I will well and faithfully discharge the duties of the office of which I am about to enter, so help me God.
Mr. Speaker, for the purposes of a colloquy, I will ask the gentleman from Illinois a question.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PREVENTING VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN BY ILLEGAL ALIENS ACT
statements.title: PREVENTING VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN BY ILLEGAL ALIENS ACT
sentences: They are already scared of contacting the police due to the deportation risk, and H.R. 30 exacerbates the real concerns that these victims will be swept up by this bill.
This bill would empower pimps and traffickers as it is written, and it will sweep more survivors into being inadmissible or deportable.

If the majority is serious about addressing the epidemic of domestic and sexual violence in our country, then we can start by addressing the funding challenges facing the Victims of Crime Act, which supports services for victims, or by expanding access to U visas and T visas, which help law enforcement protect victims.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in opposition to this dangerous legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING OUR KIDS IS NOT A PARTISAN ISSUE
statements.title: PROTECTING OUR KIDS IS NOT A PARTISAN ISSUE
sentences: In any given year, there are 390,000 children and youth who experience foster care in the United States.
Foster care impacts every congressional district across the country, regardless of whether it is red or blue or urban or rural.

It also included provisions to prevent States from separating families solely on the basis of poverty; strengthen the Indian Child Welfare Act; recover overdue child support by intercepting Federal tax funds; expand evidence-based services to prevent abuse and neglect; and support foster youth transitioning out of care, among other important provisions.
You will hear directly from advocates, child welfare professionals, and even children and families with lived experience on how we as policymakers can better the foster care system.
I am introducing myself as one of the proud co-chairs of the bipartisan Congressional Caucus on Foster Youth.
We will be having our welcome back event on Tuesday, February 11, from 10 a.m. to noon, and it is open to Members and staff willing to learn about issues related to foster youth.
